statement: Pinned Dolphin HIDAPI enumerates and opens Wii Remote raw HID devices, but explicitly warns if Linux 'wiimote' instead of 'hid-generic' is bound, because Dolphin and the kernel can both mutate extension state. The warning does not block the open, prove an actual Dolphin failure, or establish that SDL requires hid-generic; SDL Wii HIDAPI has different Linux activation policy.

applicability.revision: Dolphin e1d35f pinned software consumer; physical model unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. IOhidapi.cpp 17-59,106-162; Dolphin expects raw Wii HID replies, not kernel evdev gyro; warning is consumer policy.
